title: Great product!
text: Great product!. These are a nice size. I thought they would be small but they are a nice cupcake size. The face details are indented nicely in the mold so that when you take the cake out of the mold, you can see the raised face features! That makes decorating these so much easier. So many possibilities...

product_metadata.title: Wilton Halloween Skull Non-Stick Silicone Mold, 6-Cavity
features: Easily make skull-shaped treats for Halloween or any spooky occasion with this silicone pan
Bake brownies or mini cakes, mold candy or shape ice cream in flexible non-stick silicone
description: Create all sorts of skull-shaped treats with this non-stick silicone mold. Perfect for brownies, mini cakes or molded candies. Add spooky fun to your Halloween dessert table, or make treats to hand out as party favors.
